attr.title: Long Spear
attr.desc: This is a game on which you have a extendable spear that can become TOO LONG(Jam theme here) and this determines how you move through the levels. Enjoy 13 levels with puzzles, explosions and some enemies to kick
attr.inst: Download the LongSpearWindows_v1_1_0.zip from Itch.io (https://tsv-games.itch.io/long-spear) and place the LongSpear.pck into gamedata folder.
attr.inst_md: Download the **LongSpearWindows_v1_1_0.zip** from [Itch.io](https://tsv-games.itch.io/long-spear) and place the `LongSpear.pck` into `gamedata` folder.
